STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_11587_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_11587_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_11587 (
    MonDReg,
    break_readreg,
    clk,
    dbrk_hit0_latch,
    dbrk_hit1_latch,
    dbrk_hit2_latch,
    dbrk_hit3_latch,
    debugack,
    monitor_error,
    monitor_ready,
    reset_n,
    resetlatch,
    tracemem_on,
    tracemem_trcdata,
    tracemem_tw,
    trc_im_addr,
    trc_on,
    trc_wrap,
    trigbrktype,
    trigger_state_1,
    jdo,
    jrst_n,
    st_ready_test_idle,
    take_action_break_a,
    take_action_break_b,
    take_action_break_c,
    take_action_ocimem_a,
    take_action_ocimem_b,
    take_action_tracectrl,
    take_no_action_break_a,
    take_no_action_break_b,
    take_no_action_break_c,
    take_no_action_ocimem_a
);
    output [37:0] jdo;
    output jrst_n;
    output st_ready_test_idle;
    output take_action_break_a;
    output take_action_break_b;
    output take_action_break_c;
    output take_action_ocimem_a;
    output take_action_ocimem_b;
    output take_action_tracectrl;
    output take_no_action_break_a;
    output take_no_action_break_b;
    output take_no_action_break_c;
    output take_no_action_ocimem_a;
    input [31:0] MonDReg;
    input [31:0] break_readreg;
    input clk;
    input dbrk_hit0_latch;
    input dbrk_hit1_latch;
    input dbrk_hit2_latch;
    input dbrk_hit3_latch;
    input debugack;
    input monitor_error;
    input monitor_ready;
    input reset_n;
    input resetlatch;
    input tracemem_on;
    input [35:0] tracemem_trcdata;
    input tracemem_tw;
    input [6:0] trc_im_addr;
    input trc_on;
    input trc_wrap;
    input trigbrktype;
    input trigger_state_1;

    wire [37:0] sr;
    wire [1:0] vji_ir_in;
    wire [1:0] vji_ir_out;
    wire vji_rti;
    wire vji_sdr;
    wire vji_tck;
    wire vji_tdi;
    wire vji_tdo;
    wire vji_udr;
    wire vji_uir;

    // Internal logic for jrst_n
    assign jrst_n = reset_n && !resetlatch;

    // Internal logic for st_ready_test_idle
    assign st_ready_test_idle = !debugack && !monitor_error && monitor_ready;

    // Internal logic for take_action signals
    assign take_action_break_a = dbrk_hit0_latch && trigbrktype;
    assign take_action_break_b = dbrk_hit1_latch && trigbrktype;
    assign take_action_break_c = dbrk_hit2_latch && trigbrktype;
    assign take_action_ocimem_a = tracemem_on && tracemem_tw;
    assign take_action_ocimem_b = tracemem_on && !tracemem_tw;
    assign take_action_tracectrl = trc_on;
    assign take_no_action_break_a = !dbrk_hit0_latch && !trigbrktype;
    assign take_no_action_break_b = !dbrk_hit1_latch && !trigbrktype;
    assign take_no_action_break_c = !dbrk_hit2_latch && !trigbrktype;
    assign take_no_action_ocimem_a = !tracemem_on || (tracemem_on && !tracemem_tw);

    // Internal logic for jdo
    assign jdo = {sr, vji_ir_out};

    // Default values for unused signals
    assign vji_tck = 1'b0;
    assign vji_tdi = 1'b0;
    assign vji_sdr = 1'b0;
    assign vji_cdr = 1'b0;
    assign vji_rti = 1'b0;
    assign vji_uir = 1'b0;
    assign vji_udr = 1'b0;
    assign vji_ir_in = 2'b0;

endmodule

Generate the module

InputThe generated Stage 1 specification plus the required top-module name rtlpp_11587.
InstructionImplement the complete synthesizable RTL module from the generated specification.

Protocol summary; the Stage 2 runner creates a fresh prompt.

OutputReconstructed complete RTL module.
Stage 1 output → abstraction gate → fresh Stage 2 input. The intermediate text is generated separately for each model/attempt. It is not a prefilled golden description. Stage 2 receives neither the clean RTL nor the Stage 1 conversation.

Private final evaluation

Reference RTLClean RTL in the imported source record; hidden from Stage 2.
Score / oracleBinary formal equivalence to the hidden clean module

The formal oracle consumes the complete Stage 2 RTL file and compares it with the clean reference. A golden RTL file is scoring material, not a generated Stage 1 output.
